points: Survey of 112 executives in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, April 2026
Top uses: documentation 77%, code generation 76%, QA and code review 74%
Main obstacles: security and compliance risk 70%, tool choice 61%, process integration 58%
take: A DACH benchmark: AI coding is near universal but rarely embedded in process; security and compliance, not tools, is the main brake.
title: BearingPoint: 91% use AI in development, only 18% fully integrated
